profile.title: Profile
profile.sectionDescription: Update your display name and email address.
profile.sectionDescriptionReadOnly: Your account is managed by your identity provider.
profile.name: Name
profile.currentPasswordHint: Required when changing your email address.

toast.passwordMismatchDescription: Confirm password must match the new password.

tokens.title: Personal access tokens
tokens.description: Create tokens for docker login and CI when password or MFA login is not available.

createDialog.title: Create personal access token
createDialog.description: This token can authenticate registry push and pull operations.
createDialog.name: Name

createdDialog.title: Token created
createdDialog.description: Copy this token now. You will not be able to see it again.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate personal access token
rotateDialog.description: This generates a new secret for {name}. The current token stops working immediately.
rotateDialog.resetExpiryHint: Keeps the same validity period as when the token was originally created.
rotateDialog.resetExpiryRequired: This token is expired. Expiration must be reset to rotate.

toast.revokeSuccessDescription: The token can no longer be used.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Add an extra layer of security to your password sign-in with an authenticator app.

setup.title: Set up authenticator app
setup.description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.

disableDialog.title: Disable MFA
disableDialog.description: Enter your password and a current authenticator code to turn off two-factor authentication.

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.description: Save these codes in a secure place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.

toast.enabledDescription: Two-factor authentication is now active on your account.
toast.disabledDescription: Two-factor authentication has been turned off.
toast.backupCodesDescription: Your previous backup codes are no longer valid.

reactivate.title: Reactivate your account?
reactivate.description: This account is scheduled for deletion on {purgeDate}. You can restore it now or sign out and leave the deletion in place.
